company.shortDescription: Datoric provides licensed, ethically sourced multimodal datasets and benchmarks for training and evaluating AI models.
company.description: Datoric provides licensed, ethically sourced multimodal datasets and research benchmarks for training and evaluating AI models. The company focuses on voice, video, and computer and browser use data collected from consented contributors, with fair compensation and verifiable provenance for every sample. Its datasets support frontier AI systems that need defensible training data across speech recognition, multimodal understanding, and tool-using agents. Datoric also publishes evaluation suites such as VideoTruth-Bench, VidWork-Bench, GlobalVoice-Bench, and VoicePro-Bench to measure model behavior across safety, fairness, and procedural understanding. Customers include enterprise model teams, research labs, and machine learning operations groups that require compliant, auditable data inputs for multimodal AI development. Through its platform, Datoric emphasizes clean licensing, transparent sourcing, and end-to-end infrastructure for annotation and training data management.
